voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Cape Hatteras, North Carolina. April nineteen twenty-one. A fisherman turned in a note he said he found in a bottle. It was about a ghost ship.
Ten weeks earlier, the schooner Carroll A. Deering had been found aground offshore, sails still set. Her crew was gone.
The note said the Deering had been captured by another boat, and asked the finder to notify headquarters.
Five federal departments investigated. Handwriting experts concluded the note was forged.
The fisherman admitted forging it, reportedly hoping for work at the lighthouse. The real crew was never found.
